description: This file provides utility functions for date formatting and string conversion in a frontend application, including converting dates to ISO string inputs and displaying dates in a friendly format.

methods.name: toISODateInput(d = new Date())
methods.description: Converts a Date object or defaults to current date to an ISO formatted string suitable for input fields.

methods.name: displayDate(d)
methods.description: Formats a date value into a human-readable string ('MMM d, yyyy'); handles string ISO dates or Date objects.
